_about: Public-domain John Harris (1802-1856), Congregational minister and Principal of New College, London, for the Word Hoard: Mammon, or Covetousness the Sin of the Christian Church (1836), The Great Teacher (1835), Union, or the Divided Church Made One (1838), Zebulon, or the Moral Claims of Seamen (1837), The Great Commission (1842), Miscellanies (posthumous), The Pre-Adamite Earth (1847) and Man Primeval (1849). Howell Harris, on his own shelf, is another man. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 59 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
